products.title: Mystic Mirror Tarot Cards
products.body_html:
The Mystic Mirror Tarot brings a bold, magical presence to your readings. Its magenta-purple tones and mystical mirror design create a sense of depth and imagination that supports intuitive connection. The shifts of colour give the deck an ethereal feel, while the magenta foil edges add a whimsical touch.

This 78-card deck follows the traditional Rider–Waite imagery illustrated by Pamela Colman Smith, making it a familiar foundation for both new and experienced readers. Each deck in my collection is created with a distinct aesthetic so you can choose the one you feel most drawn to. Building a connection with your deck is an important part of tarot, and Cosmic Mirror offers a warm, inspiring space for your readings.

What’s Included;

• The entire 78 card Tarot Deck
• Standard tarot card size: 2.75" x 4.75" / 7cm x 12cm
• Super smooth Silk HD 350 GSM card stock
• All Major & Minor Arcana of the Rider Waite deck
• Custom designed Guide Book & tuck box

Please be gentle with your foil edge deck, an overhand shuffle will ensure they remain in good condition. Rough handling may cause the varnish or foil to peel away.

Please make sure your shipping address is correct.
Please contact us if you have any inquiries or questions!
Accessories/ photo props seen in the listing photos are not included.

To find out more on how to read tarot please see our detailed guide to get you started.

products.title: Tarot Cards with Meanings - Black Holographic
products.body_html:
Premium black and silver holographic tarot cards with meanings printed directly on the cards, designed to help both beginners and experienced readers interpret tarot more easily.

Small batch printing

Our tarot cards are not mass-produced. They are printed in small batches with a focus on quality and durability, making them stand out from imitation decks that often appear online.

Choose the original premium deck created for people who truly value their spiritual practice.

How this deck helps you learn tarot

The Solis Divinity Tarot deck is designed to help people learn tarot faster while still following the traditional Rider–Waite system. Each card includes keywords printed directly on the design to help readers remember the meaning of the card during a reading.

These keywords act as memory prompts, allowing beginners to interpret the cards while they practise rather than needing to memorise all 78 meanings first. Over time, many readers find the meanings become easier to remember through repeated readings.

Each card also includes helpful reference symbols such as astrology correspondences, numerology, elemental associations, and yes or no guidance to support interpretation.

Information printed on each card

• upright keywords
• reversed keywords
• astrology correspondences
• numerology references
• elemental associations
• yes / no guidance

Designed for learning and intuition

Our intention is to make tarot reading more accessible while still maintaining the beauty and symbolism that make tarot special. The deck follows the traditional 78-card Rider–Waite system, using familiar imagery that readers recognise and trust.

U.S. customers

For all U.S. customers: import duties and tariffs are already covered by us, so there are no additional fees on delivery.

New to tarot?

If you’re just starting out, you can also read our guide on how to learn tarot to help you begin your tarot journey.

Care for your foil-edge deck

Please handle your foil-edge deck gently. An overhand shuffle will help maintain the finish and keep the cards in good condition. Rough handling may cause the foil or varnish to wear over time.
